identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-21][birth-witnesses] Prepare #4762 birth witnesses and receipt package

values.summary: Prepare #4762 for later execution of an auditable birth witness register and receipt package while preserving the non-implementation boundary for this branch.

steps.action: Integrate current origin/main into /Volumes/FastWork/adl-wp-4762 on codex/4762-v0918-wp14-preparation.
Refresh SIP/STP/SPP/VPP/SRP/SOR so each card is issue-specific, preparation-only, and aligned with current WP-21 routing.
Author source-grounded design and Mermaid diagram for the later witness/receipt package.
Record exact dependencies, intended issue-local paths, COTS stance, LoC/time/token budgets, PVF lanes, rollback criteria, and no-deferral criteria.
Run bounded preparation review and apply preparation-scope fixes.
Run preparation validation and record expected claim_not_live doctor blocker without reacquiring the claim.

invariants: Preparation does not implement, publish, merge, or close #4762.
The #4762 closure condition remains implementation plus integrated proof, not planning text.
The birth witness register and receipt package must be auditable and redaction-safe when later executed.
Missing birth evidence fails closed; it is not deferred as success.
The expired claim is not reacquired during preparation.
risks: Later execution may lack current identity, continuity, memory-grounding, capability, or reviewer evidence inputs.
The historical branch name says WP14 while current routing is WP-21; the preparation artifacts must keep that correction visible.
csdlc-doctor will continue to block on claim_not_live until execution-time claim acquisition occurs.
A model/provider review may be unavailable; if so, the evidence must record the provider refusal instead of fabricating a review.
stop_conditions: Later execution requires production code, scripts, schema validators, new dependencies, cloud services, or runtime changes before SPP/VPP are revised.
Any artifact claims birthday readiness, legal personhood, production citizenship, public launch readiness, or v0.93 governance completion.
The preparation review reports an actionable preparation-scope blocker that cannot be fixed in cards/design/evidence.
Local validation finds a blocker other than the expected expired-claim gate.
replan_triggers: Later execution needs Rust, TypeScript, shell scripts, schema validators, provider calls, runtime integration, or cloud work.
WP-21 routing or v0.92 handoff source docs change after this preparation branch.
The intended witness/receipt artifact paths conflict with another issue or review packet.
Execution-time claim acquisition reports a live conflicting protected path.
